svg.title: Community Due-Diligence Sprint for Hyperscale Siting
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-community-diligence-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Community Due-Diligence Sprint for Hyperscale Siting; subtitle: Opposition is organized and winning votes, so diligence starts before the hearing; caption: 65% of residents oppose local sites, Palm Beach County denied Project Tango's expansion 5-1, and 40 of 41 Ohio county ballot initiatives ban sites above 25 MW.; assumptions note: Week buckets are a sequencing frame for practitioner operator gates; no speaker prescribed a four-week schedule. Permit checks continue monthly after Week 2.; note: Attributed to Democracy Now! (Ac0-fBK0LVQ), Careers Over Beers Podcast (S_6FoEr75bs), PBS NewsHour (fkB8mt1DEVw) and Jeff Pierson (CmmE71lfGdw).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Read the lease offer; deliverable: Flag any NDA or 'temporary' lease offer as the opening move of a data-center deal; gate: Organizers report solar pitches pivoting to hyperscale after signature (Democracy Now!); week: Week 2; title: Pull generator air permits; deliverable: Check diesel-generator air-permit filings, then repeat once a month; gate: Backup generation caught before it surfaces at a hearing (Careers Over Beers Podcast); week: Week 3; title: Test noise and water claims; deliverable: Demand dBC or dBZ fence-line readings for 24/7 operation and ask whether a closed loop is filled once or draws water every day; gate: No reliance on dBA-only numbers (Careers Over Beers Podcast, PBS NewsHour); week: Week 4; title: Document the siting posture; deliverable: Record every factor behind the siting position; gate: Documentation, not the score itself, is the legal shield (Jeff Pierson)
